note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. Canada has had an all-volunteer force since conscription ended after the Second World War. Healthcare is single-payer public insurance (Medicare) run by the provinces under the Canada Health Act and funded from taxes, so 'national_health_service' is the closest fit even though many providers are private. Immigration is managed through the points system. Same-sex marriage (2005) and cannabis legalisation (2018) came later.
